status: FROZEN_BEFORE_AUDITOR_IMPLEMENTATION; DEV_SOURCE_ONLY; NO MODEL TRAINING; NO PROTECTED_EVALUATION

dataset.variant: WSP102 independently sealed historical Wikidata-derived mirror, NOT canonical Wikidata5M

read_scope: ONLY archived wikidata5m/train.txt, after exact archive metadata and source integrity. Never extract/read valid.txt, test.txt, WSP101 original/reserved, model accept sources.

group_split.unit: all objects belonging to the same Q-subject/P-predicate query group
group_split.serialization: subject_id, predicate_id as little-endian uint32 pair
group_split.heldout: first digest byte low five bits are zero (1/32 group probability); never split a multi-valued subject-predicate group
group_split.query_priority: unsigned 64-bit big-endian digest bytes [8:16], tie-break by subject_id then predicate_id ascending
group_split.source_rows: all 21,343,681; no tuning based on sample difficulty or labels

measure.primary: source-integrity + determinism, heldout group sample SHA256, selected group and answer cardinalities, train-only edge coverage of selected subjects and their heldout target objects
measure.secondary: distribution of selected group multiplicity, source groups with no retained subject or object support, whole-process CPU/wall/peak numeric memory
measure.classification: DEV_TASK_HEADROOM_AUDIT_ONLY; train degrees do not establish causal identifiability or learner improvement

controls_not_yet_run: properly trained conventional knowledge graph representation model
random weight write and frozen old-weight control
criteria: Auditor PASS requires exact data SHA/row/bytes/relations, 4096 distinct deterministic withheld group keys, zero leaked heldout groups in retained-only scans, clean source, and immutable plan. It does not require favorable headroom counts.
stop: If no enough source groups or integrity/resources fail: preserve engineering/source negative, do not select easier queries post hoc. If conventional fully trained control later saturates, preserve negative and stop new learning mechanism for this task.
follow_on: Separate preregistration and authority required for fully trained controls, quantitative holdout prediction, claimed learning advantage, any protected benchmark labels, and scientific promotion.
